application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions:
Morelands Site

Some trees listed in the schedule are protected by Tree Preservation Orders (TPOs). However, the removal of deadwood is exempt from both TPO applications and Section 211 Notifications, unless the proposed work involves cutting into live wood.

For the Morelands site, no application is required, as trees T51, T53, T66, T68, T73, T87, and T91 are:

•	Not located within a Conservation Area; and
•	Not subject to any TPOs.

These trees can therefore be deadwooded without formal consent, provided only dead material is removed.

Thames Water Treatment – Hampton Site

Trees Protected by TPOs: 

T5 (Lime), T45 (Lime), and T47 (Lime) are protected by Tree Preservation Orders and therefore remain within this application, as the proposed works require formal consent.

•	T5 (Lime): The application for this tree is invalid, as no justification has been provided for the proposed works. Please submit a new application with justification for these works. 
•	T45 (Lime) & T47 (Lime): The works proposed to these trees are acceptable, and the application will be validated for these two trees only.

Tree Within a Conservation Area

T114 (Cotoneaster) will be removed from this application, as it is located within a Conservation Area. The applicant selected 'No' to works affecting trees in a Conservation Area, and therefore a new, separate Section 211 Notification must be submitted for this tree.
description:
T45: Tilia cordata (small-leaved lime), current height 5m. Basal growth partially obstructing footpath. Significant decay howling of 2m high stump. Pollard to 2m and trim back basal growth back to fence to clear footpath. 
T47: Tilia cordata (small-leave lime), current height 15m. Unable to fully assess base due to obstructive vegetation. Basal growth partially obstructing the footpath. Trim back basal growth back to fence to clear the footpath.  

Please refer to the invalid letter for further information regarding the other trees included in the original application.
This application is only valid for the aforementioned trees, T45 and T47.
